last.verdict: Investors shrugged off the EPS beat; flat sales and shrinking profit won out.

reasons.label: Spending crushed profit
reasons.text: Operating costs jumped 39% to $4.78B, cutting operating income 56% to $718M.

reasons.label: Flat sales, fewer cars
reasons.text: Revenue stayed near $28B year over year, and deliveries slipped 2% to 486,532.

reasons.label: Heavy AI investment
reasons.text: Capex hit $4.7B, over double last year's, with R&D up 69% to $2.76B.

story: Over the last three reports, heavy spending has been the recurring worry. April's report raised 2026 capex guidance above $25B and the stock fell 3.6%. July's capex hit $5.8B alongside an EPS miss, and shares sank. This quarter's spending again squeezed profit.
